summary: Ansible 13 community.hrobot deprecations for storagebox modules: leaving the community.hrobot.robot action group (use community.hrobot.api), hetzner_token required from 3.0.0, hetzner_user/hetzner_pass deprecated, and renamed storagebox_info and storagebox_snapshot_info return values.
